alt: 兩名年齡相仿的小女孩和小男孩蹲在水窪旁，一起用石子搭小橋，開心共用玩具水桶。
scene_prompt: Two children of the same young age, a girl and a boy around six, play cooperatively beside a shallow garden puddle. They kneel shoulder to shoulder cheerfully building a little bridge from pebbles, openly sharing their toy bucket, with trusting innocent smiles. Ordinary childhood friendship, no romantic symbols, no adult posing. Their hands and the shared game are clear.
